scope: Source-lineage correction for three prospective comparisons of software revisions on the already installed 81-photo UAE collection. All 20 photographs appear in previous project requests and earlier evaluation results. The three cohorts use 8, 7 and 5 different drives with no drive shared between cohorts. The prospective freezes protected exact new text, marked regions, grades and the comparison from the developers. Several earlier requests shared the same landmark(s) or a similar intent. These scores cannot establish generalization to globally unseen imagery or intents. The original plans remain available byte-for-byte so their pre-inference hashes can be verified. The present correction supersedes any broader novelty inference.
history_query: Matched original-photo SHA or literal recording/source URL within published experiments predating 24 November 2026. The original text comes from the release request bank bound to that SHA. Exact sentence matching ignored case and punctuation across candidate historical files. Files with only similarly named request IDs were excluded from photographic-use claims.
